title: Networks applet only shows the first IPv6 address which can be a local address
line: The Networks widget's Details tab now shows the connection's global IPv6 address even when a link-local or unique local address comes first.
explanation: The Details tab only looked at the first IPv6 address NetworkManager reports for the device. That is often the link-local fe80:: address, which is skipped, so no address row was shown at all, or a unique local fd00:: address, so the global address was never shown. The change walks all addresses, shows the first global one and falls back to the first unique local one, with the same rows as before.

commits.message:
connectiondetails: show the global IPv6 address, not just the first one

Details only looked at the first IPv6 address of the device, which is
often link-local, so nothing was shown, or unique local. It now shows
the first global address and falls back to the first unique local one.

BUG: 509743

media.caption: Link-local address listed first: the IPv6 section has no address row
Same device: IPv6 Address 2001:db8:1:2::42 is shown
ULA listed before the global address: only the IPv6 ULA Address is shown
Same device: the global IPv6 Address is shown

reviews.text: Walking all addresses in device->ipV6Config().addresses() to prefer the first global unicast address and fall back to the first ULA cleanly fixes both the link-local-first and ULA-first cases in the Networks applet Details tab. Keeping a single IPv6 address row avoids cluttering the compact popup with multiple temporary/privacy addresses and requires no new translations. The implementation in connectiondetails.cpp is minimal, safe, and thoroughly verified with before/after screenshots and regression checks.
